meta.title: Thorns
meta.author: DungeonMaster
meta.description: Take a wound while standing in briar and the thorns stay in you. Three or more and you cannot rest until you have waited long enough to pick them out. Needs a module with briar terrain; greenmarch scatters it through the fen.

systemText.thorns.caught: The briar takes its price — a barb catches and stays in. ({stacks} in you now.)
systemText.thorns.pulled: You work a thorn out and flick it away. ({stacks} left.)
systemText.thorns.lastOut: The last thorn comes free. Nothing left in you but the ache.
systemText.thorns.tooSharp: You cannot settle. There are {stacks} thorns in you, and every one of them is awake. Wait, and pick them out.
